newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine to buy back shares at market price.
newsitem.headline: Jardine to buy back shares at market price.

text.p: Jardine Davies Inc said on Thursday its board had approved a share buy back programme under which it would buy 400,000 of its shares at prevailing market price.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange that a portion of its unrestricted retained earnings would be used to buy the shares.

Jardine shares have been falling since the start of the year, down to 30 pesos on Wednesday from 75 pesos on January 9. The shares were not traded as of midsession on Thursday, but bids ranged between 18 to 25 pesos.
Jardine is involved in agriculture, building and industrial materials, housing, trading and financial services.
Jardine is 72 percent owned by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd.
